description: Permanent Account Number card issued by the Income Tax Department of India.

field_hints.pan_number: 10-character alphanumeric ID in the pattern AAAAA9999A (5 letters, 4 digits, 1 letter). Always uppercase.
field_hints.full_name: Account holder's full legal name as printed on the card.
field_hints.father_name: Father's full name as printed on the card. For companies this may be absent or replaced by the company name.
field_hints.date_of_birth: Format DD/MM/YYYY as printed on the card.
field_hints.issue_date: Date of issue if visible on the card.

validation_hints.date_of_birth: Expected format DD/MM/YYYY. Year must be plausible (1900–present).
validation_hints.father_name: May start with S/O (Son of), D/O (Daughter of), F/O (Father of).
